backgrounds.empty: No image uploaded yet: until then the background stays plain.
backgrounds.image_help: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF. It becomes a WebP up to 2560 × 1600 and covers the whole window, behind the content.
backgrounds.upload_error: The image could not be uploaded.

bug_reports.permission: Report problems (mark the screen and send)
bug_reports.title: Report a problem
bug_reports.description: A button for people to mark an area of the screen, say what is wrong and send it. The report arrives with the screenshot, the page, the screen size and the elements under the area. Who can use it is set in Permissions ("Report problems"; members by default).
bug_reports.bug_reports_button_help: The floating button shows for everyone who can report. When off, it only shows after opening the forum with ?bugs=1 in the address (it stays on in that browser until ?bugs=0), good for a test group.
bug_reports.bug_reports_full_help: Besides the marked area, keeps the whole screen for reference.
bug_reports.bug_reports_console_help: Sends the browser console errors from the last minute. It helps find the cause, but may contain page data.
bug_reports.privacy_notice: Screenshots are kept in storage/canela-bug-reports, outside the public folder: only admins and the reporter can open them. Password fields are covered in the screenshot.
bug_reports.load_failed: The reports could not be loaded. Have the theme migrations run?
bug_reports.delete_confirm: Delete this report and its screenshots? This cannot be undone.
bug_reports.save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.

settings.requires_tags: Needs the Tags extension, which is disabled.
settings.requires_fof_drafts: Needs the FoF Drafts extension, which is disabled.
settings.requires_sidebar: The sidebar is turned off (Sidebar card, above).
settings.colors_help: The theme has no colors of its own: the whole palette comes from Flarum’s primary color. The tinted background, selection, links and focus ring are all derived from it, in light and dark mode.
settings.font_help: The typeface used across the whole forum. Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans ship with the theme and cover Latin scripts; the system font downloads nothing and covers every script.
settings.font_notice: Changing the font recompiles the forum CSS, so saving takes a few seconds.
settings.tinted_background_label: Background tinted with the primary color
settings.tinted_background_help: The background behind the content and the sidebar gets a light touch of the primary color. Off, it stays a neutral grey.
settings.forum_background_help: What sits behind the content and the sidebar. The tinted gradient (with or without the blurred icons) and the tinted color pick up the primary color; plain stays a neutral grey.
settings.auth_pages_modals_label: Every link goes to the pages
settings.auth_pages_modals_help: Reply, like, follow and any other button that asks for a login also open the log in and sign up pages instead of the modals. Off, only the header buttons go to the pages.
settings.content_card_help: The list, the discussion and the profile sit on a rounded card over the background. Off, the content fills the whole area with no frame.
settings.pill_buttons_help: Buttons with fully rounded ends. Off, they get slightly rounded corners.
settings.show_title_with_logo_label: Show the forum title next to the logo
settings.show_title_with_logo_help: With a logo uploaded in Appearance, the title only shows next to it when this is on. Without a logo, the title always shows.
settings.sidebar_enabled_help: The left column with the navigation and tags. Off, the forum goes back to Flarum’s default navigation.
settings.sidebar_open_default_help: How the sidebar looks for anyone who has not opened or closed it with the header button yet. After that, each visitor’s choice wins, kept in their browser.
settings.sidebar_new_topic_help: The button at the top of the sidebar that opens the composer for a new discussion.
settings.sidebar_footer_help: The buttons at the bottom of the sidebar: light or dark theme, new discussion and keyboard shortcuts.
settings.sidebar_categories_help: The primary tags, each with its color or icon, plus the link to all tags.
settings.sidebar_tags_help: The secondary tags, plus the link to all tags.
settings.sidebar_tags_limit_help: How many secondary tags to list before the "All tags" link, from {min} to {max}.
settings.header_search_label: Search field in the middle of the header
settings.header_search_help: The search pill in the middle of the header. Off, the header goes back to Flarum’s default search.
settings.keyboard_shortcuts_help: Keyboard shortcuts: / search, c new discussion, r reply, j and k move through the list, g h goes home, = opens or closes the sidebar and ? shows the full list. They do nothing while typing in a field.
settings.welcome_banner_help: The welcome title and message from Appearance in a banner over the tinted background. Off, the page starts straight at the list.
settings.welcome_banner_guests_only_help: Logged-in members go straight to the list; the banner is for first-time visitors.
settings.welcome_banner_search_help: A large search field in the middle of the banner that opens the forum search.
settings.category_hero_help: On a tag page, a header with its icon, color, name and description before the list.
settings.category_hero_children_help: Below the header, the child tags show up as clickable cards.
settings.nav_unread_help: Discussions with replies the person has not read yet. Only shown to logged-in members.
settings.nav_hot_help: The discussions with the most replies among those started in the last few days.
settings.hot_days_help: The period considered, from {min} to {max} days.
settings.nav_dropdowns_help: The menus to the left of the tabs, to filter the list by primary tag and by secondary tag.
settings.nav_categories_link_help: A tab leading to the page with all tags.
settings.list_header_help: The row with Discussion, Replies, Views and Activity above the list.
settings.list_posters_help: The avatars of the author and of the last person to reply next to each discussion, in a posters column.
settings.list_views_help: How many times each discussion was viewed, counted by the Discussion views card.
settings.list_heat_help: Paints the counts orange or red when they are well above the rest, like a heatmap.
settings.list_excerpts_help: Below the title, the start of the first post of pinned discussions.
settings.list_status_icons_help: The pinned pin, the following star and the other status icons next to the title, in the list and in the discussion.
settings.list_status_icons_colored: Colored: each icon in its own color
settings.categories_layout_help: How the page with all tags presents them.
settings.categories_layout_boxes: Boxes: cards with the color, description and child tags
settings.categories_layout_list: List: a table of tags with their latest discussions
settings.topic_map_help: Below the first post, a summary with the creation date, the last reply, the number of replies and who took part.
settings.topic_timeline_help: The bar on the right that shows where you are in the discussion and jumps to any of its posts.
settings.topic_footer_label: Buttons at the end of the discussion
settings.topic_footer_help: Reply, share and follow after the last post. Follow needs the Subscriptions extension.
settings.topic_footer_notifications_help: The "Watching" button and the notification level sentence below the footer buttons. On desktop the timeline bell already does the same; on phones and tablets the footer one always shows, since it is the only one.
settings.suggested_topics_help: At the end of the discussion, a short list of other discussions to keep reading, preferably from the same tag.
settings.suggested_count_help: How many discussions to suggest, from {min} to {max}.
settings.user_cover_label: Cover at the top of the profile
settings.user_cover_help: A wide band behind the large avatar and the name.
settings.user_stats_help: Join date, last visit and post and discussion counts below the name. Likes only show with the Likes extension.
settings.user_summary_help: A first tab with the user’s numbers and their top discussions and replies.
settings.user_activity_read_help: Under Activity, the discussions the person has read, most recent first. Only the person and administrators can see it.
settings.user_activity_reactions_help: Under Activity, the likes and reactions the person has given in a single list, replacing Likes, with the emoji and an excerpt of the post. Reactions are only shown to those allowed to see who reacted.
settings.user_activity_votes_help: Under Activity, the posts with polls the person has voted in. Others only see polls that show their voters.
settings.user_activity_solved_help: Under Activity, the person's replies chosen as best answer.
settings.user_card_help: A compact card with the photo, the numbers and the profile link, opened from someone’s avatar or name without leaving the page.

shell.group_auth_desc: The log in and sign up pages: when they show up, their layout, background and texts.
shell.group_appearance_desc: Colors, font, surfaces, buttons, icons, banner and toasts.
shell.group_navigation_desc: Header search and menu, keyboard shortcuts and the sidebar.
shell.group_list_desc: The home page, tabs, columns, tags and counters of the discussion list.
shell.group_topic_desc: Posts, timeline, discussion map, footer and reading features.
shell.group_composer_desc: The theme composer, drafts, hashtags and advanced search.
shell.group_people_desc: Profile page, user card, extra fields and activity.
shell.group_community_desc: About, guidelines, users, groups, badges, trust levels and invites.
shell.group_moderation_desc: Staff tools: bulk actions, edit history and notices to the author.
shell.group_bugreports_desc: The button to mark the screen and report a problem, and the reports that came in.
shell.group_integrations_desc: The theme look for third-party extensions. Each one only works with its extension enabled.
shell.group_ai_desc: Provider, bot, composer helper, summaries and related discussions.
shell.group_system_desc: The system user and the messages it sends on its own: welcome, trust levels, staff, flags and suspensions.
shell.extension_disabled: Requires the {name} extension, which is installed but disabled.
shell.extension_missing: Requires the {name} extension, which is not installed.
shell.hidden_title: Hidden because they depend on something that is off
shell.auth_backend_off: The /login and /signup pages (extend/auth.php) are not loaded on the server yet: the buttons keep opening the modals.

settings.logo_colored_help: The uploaded logo becomes just its shape, painted in the accent color (and in the tag color on tag pages and discussions). Works best with an SVG or a PNG with a transparent background.
settings.loading_slider_help: When changing pages, a thin bar runs along the top of the screen until the page arrives, instead of Flarum's "Loading…" alert.

loader.title: Loading indicator
loader.help: What shows while something loads: in the list, posts, profile, modals, menus, buttons, composer, extensions and the first page load. Swap Flarum's grey ring for an animated SVG.
loader.keywords: loading loader spinner preloader indicator svg animated animation spinning
loader.custom_help: Paste the code of an animated SVG or upload an .svg file (up to 64 KB). It is cleaned on the server before saving: scripts, events and external links are removed; CSS and SMIL animations stay.
loader.custom_too_big: The file is larger than 64 KB.
loader.custom_not_svg: The file does not look like an SVG.
loader.custom_empty: Paste or upload an SVG to use this design. Until then, the forum keeps Flarum's spinner.
loader.tint_help: The SVG becomes just a shape, painted with the color below (or the text color, in buttons). Off, the file keeps its own colors.
loader.color_help: With no color chosen, the theme accent is used (the primary color, or the tag color on tag pages). In buttons the indicator follows the button text color.
loader.size_help: Relative to Flarum's spinner, from {min}% to {max}%. In buttons the indicator follows the text.
loader.notice: Changing the indicator recompiles the forum CSS; saving takes a few seconds.

settings.toast_auto_close_label: Toasts that close on their own
settings.toast_auto_close_help: Corner notices ("Saved", "Link copied"…) disappear after a few seconds, with a timer bar. When off, they stay until closed.
settings.user_menu_help: The header avatar opens the panel with tabs for notifications, replies, likes, messages, bookmarks, chat, review and profile (instead of Flarum's bell and session menu).
settings.nav_sticky_help: While scrolling the list, the tab bar sticks below the header.
settings.list_infinite_scroll_help: The next page of the list loads by itself when the end gets close to the screen. When off, Flarum's "Load more" button stays.
settings.post_actions_help: Like, copy link, bookmark, reply and the "…" that expands the rest, in each post's bar. When off, Flarum's controls menu comes back.
settings.embedded_replies_help: Each post's "N replies" opens the replies right below it, and the quoted post shows above.
settings.post_style_help: With the timeline, posts stay the same as in the default style, but a vertical line, like the avocado theme's, links one post's avatar to the next, runs through the event notices and marks the time gaps ("a month later") with a circle. From tablet width up; on phones the post stays the same.
settings.post_username_first_help: On posts, the username comes first, in bold, and the display name after it. When off, the display name comes first.
settings.topic_reply_to_style_help: How a post that replies to another shows who it replies to. In the default style, "↩ Name" on the right of the header (only when the replied post is not the one above). In avocado, a line under the name, "↳ In reply to [avatar] Name", on every reply. Clicking shows the replied post.
settings.topic_reply_to_style_discourse: Default: ↩ name on the right of the header
settings.new_replies_bar_help: Whoever is in the middle of a discussion when real-time replies arrive sees the "There are N new replies" bar, which takes them there.
settings.content_width_help: The maximum width of the content card (list, discussion, profile); in discussions, the posts column grows with it. The default is 1110px; 90% and Full width follow the screen. The preview shows the real forum on a 1440px screen.
settings.topic_sticky_avatar_help: In long posts, the author avatar follows the scroll and stays visible until the end of the post, like in the avocado theme. Desktop only.
settings.topic_event_posts_help: Show Flarum's notices such as "locked the discussion" and "pinned the discussion" in the discussion.

badges.badges_enabled_help: Automatic badges (First Like, Nice Reply, Anniversary…), the /badges page, the profile Badges tab and the "Earned …" notification. Turned off, none of it shows and the API answers 404.
badges.badges_user_card_help: Up to three featured badges (gold, silver, bronze) on the card that opens when clicking an avatar.
badges.badges_summary_help: The badges section on the profile Summary tab.
badges.badges_max_likes_per_day_label: Likes per day for the "Out of Love" badges
badges.badges_max_likes_per_day_help: Flarum does not limit likes; Out of Love, Higher Love and Crazy in Love count the days on which someone gave at least this many likes (the default is 50).
badges.run_help: The canela:badges command runs once a day through Flarum's scheduler (php flarum schedule:run in cron). The first run grants the forum's history without notifying anyone. This button runs just the badges part, now.
badges.trust_levels_enabled_help: New, Basic, Member, Regular and Leader, computed from the requirements in the card below. The level shows on the profile and earns the trust level badges. Leader is only granted by hand: on the profile, moderation menu, "Change trust level…".
badges.requires_badges: Badges are turned off (Badges and trust levels card, above).
badges.requires_trust_levels: Trust levels are turned off (Badges and trust levels card, above).
badges.source_stats: Reading measured by the theme's statistics: days visited, read time, discussions viewed and posts read are the real ones.
badges.source_core: Without the theme's statistics, reading comes from Flarum's read state (how far each person read each discussion), days visited become days since signing up, and read time doesn't count.
badges.no_likes: Without flarum/likes, the like requirements don't count.
badges.level_4_help: Never automatic: only administrators grant it, through the profile's moderation menu. Choosing a level by hand also locks it (the system won't promote or demote).
badges.tl3_requires_topics_replied_to_label: Discussions replied to in the window
badges.tl3_requires_topics_viewed_label: Discussions viewed (of those created in the window)
badges.tl3_requires_posts_read_label: Posts read (of those created in the window)
badges.tl3_promotion_min_duration_label: Grace period before losing the level
badges.table_help: Turning a badge off removes it from the /badges page and profiles and stops new grants; existing grants stay stored and come back if it's turned on again.
badges.table_failed: Couldn't load the badges. Have the theme's migrations run?
badges.unavailable: This forum lacks what the rule measures (extension turned off or theme feature missing).
badges.restore_confirm: Recreate the system badges that were removed? Existing ones (edited or not) stay as they are.
badges.restored: {count, plural, =0 {No system badge was missing.} one {# system badge restored.} other {# system badges restored.}}
badges.needs_migration: Image, "can be a title", optional manual granting and the grant reason show up after running php flarum migrate.
badges.request_failed: That did not work. Try again.
badges.remove_system_confirm: Remove the system badge "{badge}"? Its {count} grants are deleted. It only comes back with "Restore system badges" (without the old grants, which the rule redoes on the next run).
badges.remove_custom_confirm: Delete the badge "{badge}" and its {count} grants? This cannot be undone.
badges.system_notice: System badge: its automatic rule keeps working after editing.
badges.field_icon_help: Style and name, like "fas fa-star" or "far fa-heart".
badges.field_image_help: Optional: shown instead of the icon. An http(s) address of a square image.
badges.field_enabled_help: Turned off, it disappears from the forum, stops being granted and existing grants are hidden.
badges.field_allow_title: Can be used as a title
badges.field_multiple: Can be granted multiple times to the same person
badges.grant_none: No badge accepts manual granting. Create a custom badge with that option.
badges.field_reason_placeholder: A short text or a link to a post

chat.title: Chat
chat.needs_chat: Turn chat on to configure this.
chat.realtime_on: Messages arrive in real time through the flarum/realtime websocket ("php flarum realtime:serve" must be running). If it goes down, chat falls back to asking the server every few seconds.
chat.realtime_off: Without flarum/realtime, chat asks the server every few seconds for new messages. It works, with a small delay and more requests. For real time, enable flarum/realtime and run "php flarum realtime:serve".
chat.retention_notice: Cleanup runs through Flarum’s scheduler ("php flarum schedule:run" in cron every minute) and also removes uploaded images that never became a message.
chat.chat_enabled_help: The theme’s chat: public channels (standalone or tied to a tag), direct messages, threads, reactions, mentions and images, with the header icon, the drawer in the corner and the /chat page. Off, everything disappears from the forum and the API answers as if the feature didn’t exist; messages are kept.
chat.replaced_by_ramon_chat: ramon/chat is enabled: it replaces the theme’s chat, which stays off. The theme adapts its look and sidebar.
chat.chat_allowed_groups_help: Groups that see chat. Each person can still turn it off in their own settings.
chat.chat_sidebar_help: The "Channels" and "Direct messages" sections in the sidebar, below the tags, with unreads and mentions.
chat.chat_create_channel_groups_help: Besides admins. A channel can be tied to a tag, and then only people who can see the tag can see the channel.
chat.chat_moderator_groups_help: They delete and restore other people’s messages, pin messages and close, archive or delete channels. Direct messages have no moderation, nobody reads other people’s conversations.
chat.chat_dm_enabled_help: Private conversations between two people or in a group, opened with "New message" or the "Chat" button on the profile.
chat.chat_dm_groups_help: Groups whose members can start direct messages.
chat.chat_dm_max_users_help: Maximum people in a group chat, counting the creator.
chat.chat_threads_enabled_help: Replying to a message opens a separate conversation in the side panel. Each channel can still turn threads on or off in its settings.
chat.chat_pins_enabled_help: Moderators pin up to 20 messages per channel (in a DM, any participant), shown in the bar at the top of the conversation.
chat.chat_uploads_enabled_help: The composer "+", pasting and dragging images (JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP), validated like avatars. Stored in public/assets/canela-chat.
chat.chat_retention_days_help: Public channel messages older than this are permanently deleted, once a day. 0 keeps them forever.
chat.chat_dm_retention_days_help: The same for DMs. 0 keeps them forever.
chat.chat_poll_seconds_help: Without the websocket, how often (in seconds) the open conversation asks for new messages.

community.view_page: View the page on the forum
community.about_enabled_help: A page with the forum description, your own text, contact details, the staff and the site's numbers. Adds a link to the sidebar's "More" menu.
community.about_text_help: Shown below the title. Supports Markdown and BBCode (whichever the forum has enabled); if the text contains HTML tags, it is used as HTML, unformatted.
community.about_contact_email_help: Shown in the "Contact us" box. It is public: use a staff address.
community.about_contact_url_help: A full address (https://…) to a contact form or page.
community.about_show_staff_help: The "Our admins" and "Our moderators" lists. Hidden groups are left out for anyone who can't see them.
community.about_show_stats_help: Discussions, posts, sign-ups, active users and likes in the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days and all time.
community.stats_notice: The numbers only count public content and are recalculated every 30 minutes.
community.guidelines_enabled_help: The forum's community rules, in a tab next to About and in the sidebar "More" menu. /faq leads to the same page. The page only shows up with content (the text below or a fof/pages page).
community.guidelines_page_help: With a page chosen, /guidelines shows its content (with fof/pages own visibility) and the text below no longer applies. The content is then edited in fof/pages. With the text empty, the created page starts from the theme's template.
community.guidelines_page_create: Create the "Guidelines" page with the current text
community.guidelines_text_help: Accepts Markdown and BBCode; with HTML tags, it goes as HTML. Empty and without a fof/pages page, the Guidelines page doesn't show up.
community.about_pages_help: Add as many fof/pages pages as you like as tabs next to About and Guidelines, each one with the rules layout: title, section index and cards.
community.about_pages_list_help: Each page becomes a tab after About and Guidelines, in list order, at /about/id-slug and with the same layout as the Guidelines. An empty label uses the page title; the icon is a Font Awesome class. Hidden or restricted pages in fof/pages only show to people who can see them.
community.about_pages_none_left: Every fof/pages page is already on the list
community.tos_url_help: The "Terms of Service" tab and /tos lead here. A FoF Terms policy with "terms" in its name takes precedence.
community.privacy_url_help: The "Privacy Policy" tab and /privacy lead here. A FoF Terms policy with "privacy" in its name takes precedence.
community.legal_notice: Without an address (here or in FoF Terms), the tab doesn't show. Other FoF Terms policies become tabs with their own names.
community.directory_enabled_help: A table with each person's likes received and given, discussions, replies and last seen, by period, sortable by column.
community.directory_guests_help: By default, only those with the "View user list" permission (in Permissions) see the directory and group members. When on, guests can see them too, except on a private forum.
community.directory_notice: The like columns appear with the Likes extension enabled; Visits and Posts read, with the theme's statistics. Sorting by last seen follows core's permission to see when each user was online.
community.groups_enabled_help: One card per group, with its icon, color and member count, and a page for each with its members. Hidden groups only appear to those who can see them.
community.groups_activity_help: Members' recent posts on the group page.
community.groups_profile_links_label: Profile groups link to the group page
community.groups_profile_links_help: The group pills on the profile card become links to /g/group-name.

gaps.mention_cards_help: Clicking an @mention opens the user card instead of going to the profile.

integrations.messages_help: On top of flarum/messages: the profile boxes (Latest, Sent, New, Unread, Archive), per-person archive, message title, reactions and "leave message".
integrations.solved_help: The "✓ Solution" in the post bar and the accepted answer right below the first post.
integrations.reactions_help: The emoji summary in the post bar.
integrations.polls_help: Polls in a grid layout: result bars and the big vote count beside them.
integrations.links_sidebar_help: FoF Links leave the header and go to a sidebar section.
integrations.upload_progress_help: The "Uploading…" bar in the composer while a FoF Upload file is sent.
integrations.profile_cover_help: The extension's cover instead of the theme's own: in the profile banner, behind the user card (as the thumbnail, when there is one) and at the position chosen in its editor, which opens from the profile "…" menu and from Settings. The theme's own images stay stored and come back if this switch is turned off.
integrations.widgets_help: The extension's widgets as cards, like the theme's, in a column to the right of the list. The ones meant for the page sidebar (which the theme hides) go into the same column. When off, they keep the extension's look and places.
integrations.widgets_width_help: The width of the widget column next to the list, on desktop (from 200 to 480 px). The list takes the rest of the space.
integrations.thumbnails_help: The FoF Discussion Thumbnail image beside the title in the discussion list.
integrations.verified_help: The ramon/verified badge right after the name, on the text line and at its size, like a user icon: in the post header, embedded posts, "in reply to", the user card and the profile.
integrations.wiki_help: The linkrobins/wiki wiki with the theme look: the index as the discussion list, the article as the first post (with the map and the history), the discussion composer for writing (with draft, advanced options and FAQ) and the "Wiki" link in the community section of the sidebar.
integrations.ramon_chat_help: The ramon/chat extension looking like the theme's chat: the page without a second column, the drawer, messages, composer, threads and channel screens. With the extension enabled, the theme's own chat steps aside for it.
integrations.ramon_chat_sidebar_help: The "Channels" and "Direct messages" sections (with "My threads", "Search" and "Saved") in the theme sidebar; the chat page drops its own channel column.
integrations.ramon_chat_notifications_help: Chat notifications (invites, mentions, moderation) in their own tab of the user menu.
integrations.ramon_chat_user_button_label: "Chat" button on the user card and profile
integrations.ramon_chat_user_button_help: Open the direct conversation from a "Chat" button on the user card and profile, instead of an item in the "…" menu. No effect while flarum/messages is enabled: private conversations are its "Message" then.
integrations.marketplace_help: The store pages (storefront, product, cart, checkout, orders, downloads, seller dashboard, courses and plans) inside the theme card, with the title like the heroes, the theme buttons, fields, tabs and modals, colors derived from the primary color and Lucide icons.
integrations.marketplace_sidebar_help: The store links (Marketplace, Cart, Orders, Downloads, Wishlist…) in a collapsible sidebar section, instead of the menu that opened when hovering "Store".

ai.translation_enabled_help: Posts and titles written in a language other than the reader's are translated by the AI on first read and stored for everyone. The 文A next to the date toggles between the translation and the original. Each translated post is one call to the fast model.
ai.translation_locales_help: The reader's language is the one chosen in their preferences (or the forum's, for guests). Readers in an unchecked language always see the original.
ai.translation_titles_help: Discussion titles too, in the list and in the discussion, in a single call for the whole page.
ai.translation_public_only_help: Only translates what a guest could also see. Off, restricted tags also go through the model (never private messages or hidden posts).
ai.translation_daily_limit_help: Each translated post, each batch of titles and each batch of language detection counts as one. When used up, the forum shows the original until the next day. 0 = no limit.
ai.requires_provider: Set up the provider and key in the "Provider and models" card first.
ai.persona_web: Can search the web (Anthropic only; billed per search)
ai.default_persona_help: The one preselected in "New question" and in the search "Ask AI".
ai.schema_missing: The AI tables have not been created yet: run "php flarum migrate". Until then the features stay hidden.
ai.not_configured: Without an API key the AI features stay hidden in the forum. Set up the provider below and use "Test connection".
ai.provider_help: Anthropic (Claude) is the default. "OpenAI-compatible" works with OpenAI and any service with the same API (OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio…).
ai.anthropic_key_help: Create one at console.anthropic.com → API Keys. It stays on the server; the forum never receives it.
ai.anthropic_model_help: Used by the bot, summaries and the helper modes that rewrite (explain, custom prompt). Sonnet balances quality and cost; Opus is the most capable.
ai.fast_model_help: For short tasks: conversation titles, proofreading, translation, title and tag suggestions, list gists.
ai.openai_url_help: The address up to /v1; the theme appends /chat/completions. E.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1.
ai.openai_key_help: Sent as "Authorization: Bearer". A local server may not need a key.
ai.summary_min_posts_help: Smaller discussions do not show the button.
ai.personas_help: Each persona has a name, a description, the system prompt and the tools it may use. People pick the persona under the question field.
ai.allowed_groups_label: Who can use the bot, the helper and "Ask AI"
ai.allowed_groups_help: "Members" is every user with a confirmed email. Administrators always can.
ai.summary_groups_help: Anyone who can see the discussion can read a finished summary, guests included.
ai.daily_limit_help: Each question to the bot, each helper use and each generated summary counts one. 0 = no limit. Administrators have no limit.
ai.requires_related: Turn on "Related discussions" in the Features card.
ai.embeddings_help: Anthropic has no embeddings API: use an OpenAI-compatible one (OpenAI, Voyage, Mistral, Ollama…). To embed everything at once: "php flarum canela:ai-embeddings --all".
ai.enabled_help: When off, no AI feature appears in the forum and the AI API answers 404.
ai.bot_enabled_help: The /ai/conversations page: questions to the AI, with the conversation list in the sidebar, personas and streamed answers. With the personas that may, the AI searches and reads the forum (only what the person can see) and cites the discussions.
ai.bot_header_icon_help: Opens the conversations; inside them, goes back to where the person was.
ai.search_enabled_help: The search field becomes "Search or Ask AI", and the search modal offers "Ask AI: <query>", which opens the conversation.
ai.helper_enabled_help: The ✨ button in the composer toolbar: proofread, translate, simplify, explain, generate a table, custom prompt, suggest a title and suggest tags, with a preview of the changes and "Confirm/Discard".
ai.summary_enabled_help: The "Summarize" button in the discussion map opens the panel with the streamed summary. The summary is stored and everyone who sees the discussion can read it; when the discussion gets new replies it shows as outdated, with "Regenerate".
ai.gists_enabled_help: One AI-written sentence instead of the excerpt, on the most active discussions. Generated hourly by the scheduler ("php flarum schedule:run" in cron), up to 20 per run, each one is a call to the fast model.
ai.related_enabled_help: At the end of the discussion, the discussions closest in meaning. Needs the embeddings API (set up here, with the feature on); vectors are generated hourly and on the first visit to each discussion.

auth.pages_label: Full-page log in and sign up
auth.pages_help: The Log In and Sign Up header buttons open the /login and /signup pages. When off, they open the modals.
auth.layout_card_help: How the log in and sign up pages are arranged on screen and what sits behind the form.
auth.texts_card_help: The title and subtitle of each page. Leave empty to keep the theme default.
auth.layout_help: In all of them the page has no header, only the forum logo. With social login, the buttons come before the form (beside it in the side-by-side one).
auth.layout_discourse: Side by side: no card, social login beside the form
auth.layout_split: Split screen: colored panel on the left
auth.background_label: Log in and sign up background
auth.background_help: In the split screen the image goes to the left panel; the other backgrounds sit behind the form.

events.title: Events
events.backend_off: The events backend (extend/events.php) is not loaded on the server yet.
events.events_enabled_help: "Create event" in the composer ⊕ menu puts an event in the first post: date, time and time zone, recurrence, stream address, location and attendee limit. The post shows the card with "Going", "Interested" and "Not going", the attendees and "Add to calendar" (Google and .ics). When off, the card becomes text and the API answers as if the feature did not exist.
events.events_tag_help: The "Create event" button only shows when starting a discussion in this tag, and only its discussions show the event card, appear in "Upcoming events" and send reminders. Whoever can start a discussion in the tag can create events (the tag's own permissions). With "Any tag", it applies to every discussion.
events.events_list_badge_label: Date in the list and the header
events.events_list_badge_help: The event date ("in 3 days", "2 days ago") next to the title in the discussion list and in the topic header.
events.events_upcoming_help: The "Events" link in the sidebar, the /events page (list and calendar) and, at the top of the events tag list, the next dates.
events.events_chat_help: The builder gets the "Event chat" option: a ramon/chat channel just for the event, bound to the discussion tag; whoever marks "Going" joins the channel.
events.events_docked_chat_help: On desktop, the event channel sits in a full-height column to the right of the topic. On phones and tablets, the card links to the chat.
events.events_reminder_minutes_help: How many minutes before each occurrence the people who marked "Going" get the alert. Zero turns the reminder off.
events.reminders_notice: Reminders go out through the Flarum scheduler every five minutes: the server must run "php flarum schedule:run" from cron every minute.

cooked.backend_off: The footnote and table of contents syntax (extend/cooked.php) is not loaded on the server yet.
cooked.footnotes_help: Footnotes: "text[^1]" with "[^1]: the note" at the end of the post, or the inline note "^[the note]". The number shows small, above the line, and a click opens the note in a tooltip. The composer ⊕ menu gets "Footnote". When off, notes stay as "[1]" and "[1]: text".
cooked.toc_help: With [toc] in the first post (the composer ⊕ menu has "Insert table of contents"), its headings show in the timeline column, with the current heading marked and "Jump to end". The button below switches between "Contents" and "Timeline", and the choice is kept in the browser. On phones, the table of contents lives in the timeline sheet.
cooked.toc_min_headings_help: With fewer headings than this in the first post, the table of contents does not show.
cooked.toc_auto_tags_label: Automatic table of contents in these tags
cooked.toc_auto_tags_help: In discussions of these tags, the first post gets the table of contents even without [toc] (as long as it has enough headings).

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.bookmarks_enabled_help: Members bookmark posts to come back to later, with an optional name and reminder, and find them all in the "Bookmarks" tab of their own profile. When off, the buttons disappear and the API answers as if the feature did not exist, existing bookmarks are kept.
bookmarks.bookmarks_topic_button_help: Adds "Bookmark discussion" to the discussion controls (the "…" menu in the footer). It bookmarks the first post.
bookmarks.bookmarks_user_menu_help: A "Bookmarks" shortcut in the avatar menu, right below "Profile".
bookmarks.reminders_notice: Reminders are sent by Flarum's scheduler every five minutes, the server must run "php flarum schedule:run" from cron every minute. Without cron, bookmarks work but no reminder is sent.

composer.enabled_help: The master switch: when off, the composer is plain Flarum, without any of the features below.
composer.emoji_help: The toolbar emoji button opens a picker with search, categories, recently used and skin tones. With the Emoji extension, emoji are shown as its images.
composer.emoji_notice: The Emoji extension is disabled: the picker uses system emoji and the theme provides the ":name" autocomplete.
composer.preview_help: On desktop, the formatted post is shown to the right of the editor. Everyone can hide it with the « button in the editor corner.
composer.similar_help: While writing a new discussion title (three words or more), shows "Your discussion is similar to…" with up to five related discussions.
composer.linked_topic_help: In the reply composer, the "↩ ▾" menu turns the reply into a new discussion with the same text, a link back and the same tags.
composer.drafts_help: With the FoF Drafts extension, the theme handles drafts like this: new discussions and replies are saved automatically two seconds after typing stops, replying to a discussion resumes its draft, closing with text asks whether to discard or keep it, and the Start a Discussion button gets a ⌄ with the list. They are also in the user menu and in the profile Drafts tab.
composer.drafts_note: Drafts are stored by fof/drafts (drafts table), which also handles permissions and scheduling. Post edits have no draft.
composer.hashtags_help: Typing # in the editor suggests tags and inserts a link to them; in posts, these links (and the tag mentions of the Mentions extension) become the pill with the tag symbol.
composer.hashtags_mentions_notice: With the Mentions extension enabled, the editor # belongs to it (tag mention); the theme only draws mentions as hashtags.
composer.requires_composer: The composer features are disabled (Theme composer card, above).

extras.search_page_enabled_help: A /search page: discussion, post, tag and user tabs, advanced filters (author, primary tag, tags, title only, liked, status, dates, minimum posts) and sorting. The search modal gains an “Advanced search” link.
extras.search_notice: The filters also become shortcuts you can type in the search: in:title, in:likes, in:bookmarks and min-posts:5, next to Flarum’s own (author:, tag:, is:locked…).
extras.bulk_select_enabled_help: A button in the list bar turns on checkboxes on each discussion and an action bar: mark as read, pin, close, change tags, hide and delete. It only shows for people who can moderate some discussion in the list, and each action only applies where they have permission.
extras.top_periods_enabled_label: Period selector on the Top tab
extras.top_periods_enabled_help: The Top tab shows “All time / Year / Quarter / Month / Week / Today”, limiting the list to discussions created in that range.
extras.text_size_enabled_help: In Settings, each person picks Smaller, Normal, Larger or Largest. The choice applies to the device (it is stored in the browser).
extras.banner_enabled_help: A strip above the content, on every page, with a close button. Whoever closes it won’t see it again, until the text changes.
extras.banner_text_help: Markdown, BBCode and emoji, as in a post. For HTML, start the text with an HTML tag (p, div…). When empty, the banner is not shown.
extras.banner_reshow: Show again to those who closed it
extras.banner_reshow_done: The banner will show again for everyone.
extras.print_topic_enabled_help: Loads every post into a clean view (no sidebar, header or timeline) and opens the browser’s print dialog, which can also save as PDF.
extras.post_history_enabled_label: Store and show the edit history
extras.post_history_enabled_help: Each edit keeps the previous text. The post’s “Edited” becomes a pencil with the number of revisions, which opens the comparison between versions (inline or side by side).
extras.history_notice: Only edits made while the feature is on are recorded. When off, nothing new is stored and the history disappears from the forum, what was already stored stays in the database. The text of a hidden post’s versions is only shown to those who can edit it.
extras.post_history_public_help: When off, only the post’s author and those who can edit it open the history; everyone else sees Flarum’s “Edited”.

settings.lucide_icons_help: Interface icons (search, bell, reply, like, menus…) drawn with Lucide's thin stroke. When off, the solid Font Awesome icons come back. Icons with no Lucide replacement (brands and some of those picked for tags and groups) stay in Font Awesome.

metoo.title: Me too
metoo.enabled_label: "Me too" button on the first post
metoo.enabled_help: The "✋ Me too" pill below the first post: people with the same issue click it, the count shows in parentheses and they start following the discussion. The author and locked discussions see a read-only button; guests are sent to log in. When off, the button disappears and the API answers 404; existing marks are kept.
metoo.tags_help: Tick the support tags (for example: Support, Bug…). None ticked means every discussion. Ticking a parent tag includes its children.
metoo.hide_solved_label: Hide once the discussion is solved
metoo.hide_solved_help: When a best answer is chosen (FoF Best Answer) the button disappears, and comes back if the solution is removed. When off, it stays on solved discussions ("multiple solutions" mode).
metoo.follow_help: Clicking "Me too" makes the person follow the discussion (Subscriptions extension) to hear about the solution. People already following stay as they are; unmarking does not unfollow.
metoo.no_best_answer_notice: Without the FoF Best Answer extension no discussion counts as solved: the button stays on every chosen discussion.

profile.blocked_by_master: Turn on the extra fields in the "Extended profile" card.
profile.profile_enabled_help: Profile fields: everyone can say who they are, where they are and what they're up to. When off, the fields disappear from the forum and the API, but what was filled in is kept.
profile.profile_bio_help: Short text on the profile and the user card. Supports links, **bold**, *italic* and `code`; no HTML.
profile.profile_location_help: City or region, with a map icon on the profile.
profile.profile_website_help: An http or https address, opened in a new tab and marked nofollow.
profile.profile_birthday_help: Optional date of birth. Others only see the day and month unless the person chooses to show the year.
profile.profile_title_help: A short title (up to 60 characters) on the profile, the user card and next to the name on posts.
profile.profile_title_self_help: When off, only those who can edit users (moderators) set titles, a distinction given by the staff.
profile.profile_status_help: An emoji and a phrase ("🌴 On vacation until Friday") next to the name on posts, on the card and on the header avatar. People choose when the status clears itself.
profile.profile_cover_help: A wide cover at the top of the profile and a background for the user card. Without an image, the cover uses the user's color.
profile.profile_cover_upload_help: Images are downscaled (cover to 2000px, card to 900px), converted to WebP and stored in assets/canela-covers. When off, only an https image address is accepted.
profile.cover_notice: External addresses must be https. Visitors' browsers load the image straight from the other site.
profile.cover_forumaker_notice: forumaker/profile-cover is active: the profile cover comes from it (Integrations → Profile cover). The card background still belongs to the theme; without one of its own, the card uses the thumbnail of that cover. A cover uploaded here stays stored, but is not shown while it is in charge.

stats.stats_links_enabled_help: Every click on an external link in a post is counted: the number shows next to the link, "Popular links" in the discussion map and "Top links" in the profile summary.
stats.links_notice: One click per link per person (or IP, for guests) every 24 hours; bots don't count. Only external links that are in the post.
stats.stats_views_enabled_help: Each discussion counts how many times it was opened. The number shows in the list's Views column and allows sorting by most viewed.
stats.stats_view_window_hours_label: Hours before counting the same person again
stats.stats_view_window_hours_help: Count a new discussion view once per IP/user every N hours, and always again on a new day. From {min} to {max} hours; the default is 8.
stats.views_notice: One view per discussion per day for each account (or IP, for guests), locked by the hours above; only people who can see the discussion count, and crawlers do not. The IP of signed-in people is not stored, and guests' IPs are kept only as a salted code, never the IP itself. Each day is kept for the "Recent views" chart in the discussion map.
stats.heat_help: The heat colors of the list's Views column (heatmap). They apply when "Highlight high counts" is on in the Discussion list.
stats.topic_views_heat_low_help: After this many views, the views field is slightly highlighted. The default is 1000.
stats.topic_views_heat_medium_help: After this many views, the views field is moderately highlighted. The default is 2000.
stats.topic_views_heat_high_help: After this many views, the views field is strongly highlighted. The default is 3500.
stats.stats_counts_enabled_help: For signed-in users: "New (3)" and "Unread (2)" on the list tabs, and a dot next to All Discussions in the sidebar when there is something new.
stats.stats_new_days_help: Discussions created in this period that the person has not opened yet. 0 counts everything since sign-up or the last "mark all as read". From {min} to {max}; the default is 2.
stats.stats_activity_enabled_help: Days visited, read time (total and last 60 days), posts read, discussions viewed and likes given and received, in the profile summary.
stats.activity_notice: Read time only counts while the tab is visible and someone is using the page. The numbers start from zero on the day the feature is turned on; discussions viewed depends on Views being on.

ramon_chat_features.review_flags_help: Reported chat messages join the theme review queue (page, sidebar and user menu), alongside posts and ordered by date, for whoever sees flags or moderates the chat.
ramon_chat_features.title: Extra chat features (ramon/chat)
ramon_chat_features.description: What ramon/chat lacks: bell notifications, one-click reactions, "New message", starred channels, message links, "is typing" without websocket and more, without changing the extension.
ramon_chat_features.backend_off: The theme's "ramonchat" feature did not load (check the PHP error log).
ramon_chat_features.dm_max_help: Including whoever starts the conversation. ramon/chat accepts at most 20.
ramon_chat_features.preferences_help: Enable chat, sound, header indicator, send key, one-click reactions, drawer, mention e-mails and "Ignore channel-wide mentions".
ramon_chat_features.header_indicator_help: Each reader picks what the chat button counts: all new messages, DMs and mentions, mentions only or nothing.
ramon_chat_features.drawer_shortcut_help: Opens and closes the chat drawer.
ramon_chat_features.bell_help: Mentions (@here only for people active in the last 5 minutes) and new messages in watched channels become notifications; reading the channel marks them read.
ramon_chat_features.quick_reactions_help: The reader's three most used reactions (or the ones they choose) next to 👍.
ramon_chat_features.permalink_help: "Copy link" in the actions, and the address that opens the conversation at the message.
ramon_chat_features.restore_help: The button on the deleted-message notice, for whoever may restore it.
ramon_chat_features.long_press_help: Holding a message opens the action sheet from the bottom.
ramon_chat_features.collapse_deleted_help: "N messages were deleted" on a single line, with "view all".
ramon_chat_features.paste_upload_help: Images and files pasted or dropped on the composer are uploaded as attachments.
ramon_chat_features.mention_warning_help: In the composer @ list, people outside the channel show "not a member of the channel".
ramon_chat_features.typing_poll_help: Without flarum/realtime, whoever has the conversation open asks the server every 3 seconds.
ramon_chat_features.new_message_help: The DM and group DM dialog (people search, counter, group name) and the "+" of Direct messages.
ramon_chat_features.self_dm_help: A conversation of your own, for notes.
ramon_chat_features.group_name_help: Any participant may rename the group conversation.
ramon_chat_features.starred_help: The star in the header and in Channel info; starred channels go to the top of the sidebar.
ramon_chat_features.pin_bar_help: The bar follows the part of the conversation in view, with an indicator for several pins; clicking cycles through them, the "×" hides the bar for that reader only, and the panel lists pins in conversation order, with who pinned them.
ramon_chat_features.pin_indicator_help: A dot on the pinned-message bar when there is a pin the reader has not opened yet.
ramon_chat_features.retention_help: How long messages are kept, in Channel info.
ramon_chat_features.delete_confirm_label: Delete channel by typing its name
ramon_chat_features.delete_confirm_help: Deleting a channel asks for its name to be typed, instead of an "OK".
ramon_chat_features.auto_join_help: People who gained access later join channels set to "Automatically add users" (at most once a day per person).
ramon_chat_features.tag_cleanup_help: Deleting a tag deletes its channels.
ramon_chat_features.dm_guard_help: Refuses DMs with people who cannot use the chat or turned it off, and applies the participant limit below.

system_user.title: System user
system_user.help: A system account: it signs automatic notifications (bookmark reminders and badges) and the automated messages below. It's a regular user on the forum, with a profile, avatar and bio, but it never logs in: no login, password, password reset or session. Nobody can message it, and it's left out of the users directory.
system_user.bio: Not a real person. A global user for system notifications and other system tasks.
system_user.profile_hint: Change its avatar, name and bio from its profile, like any other user.
system_user.unlink_confirm: Unlink the system user? The account stays, but notifications go back to having no sender and automated messages stop until you create or link another one.
system_user.missing: There's no system user yet. Without one, automatic notifications have no sender and no automated message is sent.
system_user.messages_notice: Automated messages are private messages: they need the Messages extension (flarum/messages) enabled.
system_user.needs_user: Create the system user first (card above).
system_user.no_replies_notice: The conversation with the system user is one-way: recipients can't reply, since nobody reads its inbox.

custom.title: Custom messages
custom.help: Your own messages, besides the built-in ones: choose when each one goes out (account activated, days later, group, trust level, badge, first post, account anniversary, verified account). Each one is sent only once per person.
custom.delay_help: Sent by Flarum's scheduler (php flarum schedule:run in cron), and only to people who sign up after the message is created.
custom.anniversary_help: Sent by Flarum's scheduler on the sign-up anniversary, only for anniversaries after the message is created.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.default_hint: Empty, the default text applies (the one greyed out in the field), in the recipient's language.

welcome_user.title: Welcome
welcome_user.help: For someone who just activated their account (confirmed their email, or signed up already confirmed). Sent only once per person.
welcome_user.subject: Welcome to %{site_name}!
welcome_user.body:
Thanks for joining %{site_name}, and welcome!

We believe in [civilized community behavior](%{guidelines_url}) at all times.

Enjoy your stay!

welcome_invite.title: Welcome by invite
welcome_invite.help: Instead of the regular welcome, for someone who joined through an invite link.
welcome_invite.subject: Welcome to %{site_name}!
welcome_invite.body:
Thanks for accepting your invitation to %{site_name} -- welcome!

- We've created this new account **%{username}** for you. Change your name or password in [your settings](%{user_preferences_url}).

We believe in [civilized community behavior](%{guidelines_url}) at all times.

Enjoy your stay!

welcome_tl1_user.title: Trust level 1
welcome_tl1_user.help: When someone moves up to trust level 1 (Basic). Needs trust levels enabled.
welcome_tl1_user.subject: Thanks for spending time with us
welcome_tl1_user.body:
Hey there. We see you've been busy reading, which is fantastic, so we've promoted you up a trust level!

We're really glad you're spending time with us and we'd love to know more about you. Take a moment to [fill out your profile](%{user_url}), or feel free to [start a new discussion](%{base_url}).

tl2_promotion_message.title: Trust level 2
tl2_promotion_message.help: When someone moves up to trust level 2 (Member). Needs trust levels enabled.
tl2_promotion_message.subject: Congratulations on your trust level promotion!
tl2_promotion_message.body:
We've promoted you up another trust level!

Achieving trust level 2 means that you have read and actively participated enough to be considered a member of this community.

We invite you to keep getting involved: we enjoy having you around.

welcome_staff.title: Joined the staff
welcome_staff.help: When someone joins the Admin or Moderators group.
welcome_staff.subject: Congratulations, you've been granted %{role} status!
welcome_staff.body:
You've been granted %{role} status by a fellow staff member.

It comes with the staff tools, and with great power comes great responsibility. If you're new to moderating, please read the [community guidelines](%{guidelines_url}).

user_added_to_group_as_member.title: Added to a group
user_added_to_group_as_member.help: When someone joins another group (other than Admin and Moderators). Off by default.
user_added_to_group_as_member.subject: You have been added to the %{group_name} group
user_added_to_group_as_member.body: You have been added as a member of the [%{group_name}](%{base_url}%{group_path}) group.

flags_agreed_and_post_deleted.title: Flagged post removed
flags_agreed_and_post_deleted.help: When staff hides or deletes a post that had flags. Needs the Flags extension (flarum/flags).
flags_agreed_and_post_deleted.subject: Flagged post removed by staff
flags_agreed_and_post_deleted.body:
Hello,

This is an automated message from %{site_name} to let you know that [your post](%{base_url}%{url}) was removed.

%{flag_reason}

This post was flagged by the community and a staff member opted to remove it.

```
%{flagged_post_raw_content}
```

Please review our [community guidelines](%{guidelines_url}) for details.

silenced_by_staff.title: Account suspended
silenced_by_staff.help: When staff suspends the account. Needs the Suspend extension (flarum/suspend).
silenced_by_staff.subject: Account suspended
silenced_by_staff.body:
Hello,

This is an automated message from %{site_name} to let you know that your account has been suspended until %{suspended_till}.

%{reason}

You can still browse the forum, but you won't be able to take part until the suspension ends. If you have questions, contact the [staff](%{base_url}/about).

unsilenced.title: Suspension lifted
unsilenced.help: When the suspension is lifted. Needs the Suspend extension (flarum/suspend).
unsilenced.subject: Your account is no longer suspended
unsilenced.body:
Hello,

This is an automated message from %{site_name} to let you know that your account is no longer suspended.

You can now create new discussions and replies again. Thank you for your patience.

notification.setting: When an event I am going to is about to start

builder.name: Event name
builder.name_placeholder: The discussion title, if left empty
builder.status_public_help: Anyone who can see the discussion answers going, interested or not going.
builder.status_standalone_help: Only the date and details, without the RSVP buttons.
builder.chat_help: Creates a chat channel just for the event; whoever marks "Going" joins it, and on desktop it sits beside the topic.
builder.error_end: The end must be after the start.

translation.original_language: This post was originally written in {language}.
translation.title_original_language: This title was originally written in {language}.

prefs.title: Content language preferences
prefs.understood_help: Topics and posts in these languages won't be translated. Your interface language is always considered understood.
prefs.auto_translate: Automatically translate topics and posts in other languages

errors.generic: The AI could not answer right now. Please try again.

tools.searched: Searched for "{query}": {count, plural, =0 {no results} one {# result} other {# results}}
tools.read_missing: Tried to read a discussion that is not available

bot.title: AI bot
bot.disclaimer: Generative AI can make mistakes. Verify important information.
bot.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {You have used all of today's requests.} one {# request left today.} other {# requests left today.}}
bot.shortcut_title: Start a conversation with the AI bot
bot.sidebar_empty: Bot conversation history will appear here.
bot.delete_confirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
bot.not_allowed: You do not have access to the AI bot.
bot.log_in: Log in to talk to the AI bot.

summary.title: Discussion summary
summary.outdated_posts: {count, plural, one {(# post missing)} other {(# posts missing)}}
summary.empty: There is no summary for this discussion yet.

helper.no_content_error: Add content first to perform AI actions on it

preview.banner: Preview: nothing has been applied yet. Only you see this version, in this tab.

auth.panel_login_text: Log in to keep up with the conversations, reply and follow what matters to you.
auth.panel_signup_text: Create your account to take part in discussions, follow topics and get notifications.
auth.reset_help: Choose a new password for your account (at least 8 characters).

badges.unavailable: Badges are turned off on this forum.
badges.not_found: This badge does not exist or has been turned off.
badges.no_recipients: Nobody has earned this badge yet.

trust_level_modal.title: Trust level of {username}
trust_level_modal.locked_help: The trust level is locked: the system will not promote or demote this user.
trust_level_modal.unlocked_help: The trust level is unlocked: the system may promote or demote this user based on the requirements.

modal.existing_reminder: You will be reminded about this bookmark on {date}.
modal.invalid_date: Choose a date and time in the future.

first_like.name: First Like
first_like.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you like a post. Liking posts is a great way to let your fellow community members know that what they posted was interesting, useful, cool, or fun. Share the love!

first_quote.name: First Quote
first_quote.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you quote a post in your reply. Quoting relevant sections of earlier posts in your reply helps keep discussions connected together and on topic. Quote away!

first_link.name: First Link
first_link.description: Added a link to another discussion
first_link.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you link to another discussion. Linking discussions helps fellow readers find interesting related conversations, by showing the connections between discussions in both directions. Link freely!

first_mention.name: First Mention
first_mention.description: Mentioned a user in a post
first_mention.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you mention someone's @username in your post. Each mention generates a notification to that person, so they know about your post. Just start typing @ (at symbol) to mention any user.

first_emoji.name: First Emoji
first_emoji.description: Used an emoji in a post
first_emoji.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you add an emoji to your post. Emoji let you convey emotion in your posts, from happiness to sadness, anger, and everything in between.

first_flag.name: First Flag
first_flag.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you flag a post. Flagging is how we all help keep this a nice place for everyone. If you notice any posts that require moderator attention for any reason please don't hesitate to flag.

editor.name: Editor
editor.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you edit one of your posts. We encourage editing: you can improve formatting, fix small mistakes, or add anything you missed when you originally posted. Edit to make your posts even better!

autobiographer.name: Autobiographer
autobiographer.long_description: This badge is granted for filling out your user profile and selecting a profile picture. Letting the community know a bit more about who you are and what you're interested in makes for a better, more connected community. Join us!

reader.name: Reader
reader.description: Read every reply in a discussion with more than 100 replies
reader.long_description: This badge is granted the first time you read a long discussion with more than 100 replies. Reading a conversation closely helps you follow the discussion, understand different viewpoints, and leads to more interesting conversations.

new_user_of_the_month.name: New User of the Month
new_user_of_the_month.description: Outstanding contributions in their first month
new_user_of_the_month.long_description: This badge is granted to congratulate two new users each month for their excellent overall contributions, as measured by how many people liked their posts.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.long_description: This badge is granted when you receive your first like on a post. Congratulations, you've posted something that your fellow community members found interesting, cool, or useful!

anniversary.name: Anniversary
anniversary.description: Active member for a year, posted at least once
anniversary.long_description: This badge is granted when you've been a member for a year with at least one post in that year. Thank you for sticking around and contributing to our community. We couldn't do it without you.

appreciated.name: Appreciated
appreciated.long_description: This badge is granted when you receive at least one like on 20 different posts. The community is enjoying your contributions to the conversations here!

respected.name: Respected
respected.long_description: This badge is granted when you receive at least 2 likes on 100 different posts. The community is growing to respect your many contributions to the conversations here.

admired.name: Admired
admired.long_description: This badge is granted when you receive at least 5 likes on 300 different posts. Wow! The community admires your frequent, high quality contributions to the conversations here.

thank_you.name: Thank You
thank_you.description: Has 20 liked posts and gave 10 likes
thank_you.long_description: This badge is granted when you have 20 liked posts and give 10 or more likes in return. When someone likes your posts, you find the time to like what others are posting, too.

gives_back.name: Gives Back
gives_back.description: Has 100 liked posts and gave 100 likes
gives_back.long_description: This badge is granted when you have 100 liked posts and give 100 or more likes in return. Thanks for paying it forward!

empathetic.name: Empathetic
empathetic.description: Has 500 liked posts and gave 1000 likes
empathetic.long_description: This badge is granted when you have 500 liked posts and give 1000 or more likes in return. Wow! You're a model of generosity and mutual appreciation.

out_of_love.name: Out of Love
out_of_love.long_description: This badge is granted when you give {max} likes in a single day. Remembering to take a moment and like the posts you enjoy encourages your fellow community members to create even more great discussions in the future.

higher_love.name: Higher Love
higher_love.description: Used {max} likes in a day 5 times
higher_love.long_description: This badge is granted when you give {max} likes in a single day on 5 different days. Thanks for taking the time actively encouraging the best conversations every day!

crazy_in_love.name: Crazy in Love
crazy_in_love.description: Used {max} likes in a day 20 times
crazy_in_love.long_description: This badge is granted when you give {max} likes in a single day on 20 different days. Wow! You're a model of regularly encouraging your fellow community members!

enthusiast.name: Enthusiast
enthusiast.long_description: This badge is granted for visiting 10 consecutive days. Thanks for sticking with us for over a week!

aficionado.name: Aficionado
aficionado.long_description: This badge is granted for visiting 100 consecutive days. That's more than three months!

devotee.name: Devotee
devotee.long_description: This badge is granted for visiting 365 consecutive days. Wow, an entire year!

nice_post.name: Nice Reply
nice_post.long_description: This badge is granted when your reply gets 10 likes. Your reply really made an impression on the community and helped move the conversation forward!

good_post.name: Good Reply
good_post.long_description: This badge is granted when your reply gets 25 likes. Your reply was exceptional and made the conversation more engaging for everyone!

great_post.name: Great Reply
great_post.long_description: This badge is granted when your reply gets 50 likes. Wow! Your reply was inspiring, fascinating, hilarious, or insightful and the community loved it.

nice_topic.name: Nice Discussion
nice_topic.long_description: This badge is granted when your discussion gets 10 likes. Hey, you started an interesting conversation that the community enjoyed!

good_topic.name: Good Discussion
good_topic.long_description: This badge is granted when your discussion gets 25 likes. You launched a vibrant conversation that the community rallied around and loved!

great_topic.name: Great Discussion
great_topic.long_description: This badge is granted when your discussion gets 50 likes. You kicked off a fascinating conversation and the community enjoyed the dynamic discussion that resulted!

basic_user.name: Basic
basic_user.long_description: This badge is granted when you reach trust level 1. Thanks for sticking around a little while and reading a few discussions to learn what our community is about.

member.name: Member
member.description: Granted the trust of someone who has participated for weeks
member.long_description: This badge is granted when you reach trust level 2. Thanks for participating over a period of weeks to truly join our community.

regular.name: Regular
regular.description: Granted the trust of a consistent contributor
regular.long_description: This badge is granted when you reach trust level 3. Thanks for being a regular part of our community over a period of months. You're now one of the most active readers, and a reliable contributor that makes our community great.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: Chosen by the staff as an example for the community
leader.long_description: This badge is granted when you reach trust level 4. You're a leader in this community as selected by staff, and you set a positive example for the rest of the community in your actions and words here.
